versions.changelog:
- Initial release for cravego-caption-script-writer.
- Generates friendly, casual captions for CraveGo.ph focused only on new user/signup promos.
- Supports Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok/Reels with platform-specific formats.
- Ensures safe phrasing and includes a clear signup call-to-action.
- TikTok scripts feature a scene-by-scene outline with an engaging hook.
- Output is structured in JSON for easy integration.
